name: state
meaning: BullState (bull_SetState writes it at entry and exit)

name: chargeSpeed
meaning: charge and return speed in u/s: 800, or 1100 when the target is Gossamer_Lev08 (0x44c)

name: hitTime
meaning: g_gameTime at SetState(4); state 4 goes back to state 2 after 0xa000 ticks

name: stateTime
meaning: g_gameTime at SetState(1/6/3); 2-s charge timeout, 1-s slide

name: tossClockBase
meaning: g_gameTime of the last frame that was not tossing; the toss arc advances by (now - this)*256/0x28000 per frame

name: homeFacing
meaning: rot.y at Init; restored by SetState(0)

name: skidFacing
meaning: facing saved by SetState(3); never read

name: targetDist
meaning: XZ distance output of Scenaric_FindBestInRadius in SetState(1); a hit is used only when < 900

name: wakeUpSpeedPct
meaning: PROPERTY_BULL_WAKEUPSPEED; wake anim 0xe speed = pct*0x1000/100

name: woken
meaning: wake anim started; cleared by SetState(0) when asleep

name: chasingGossamer
meaning: set when a charge targets class 0x57; only Init clears it; makes Reset restart the charge

name: asleep
meaning: PROPERTY_BULL_ASLEEP

name: chargeTargetPos
meaning: target position snapshotted when a charge starts; the charge runs straight at it

name: velocity
meaning: charge velocity (x, 250, z) in u/s; SetState(9) makes it (x/4, y*4, z/4)

name: homePos
meaning: ground-snapped Init position; target of state 8 and Reset

name: sheepCam
meaning: Scn_GetPropCamera(SHEEPCAM); CamShot started when a sheep is caught in SHEEPBOX

name: sheepTraj
meaning: Scn_GetPropTrajectory(SHEEPTRAJ); points 0..2 define the toss arc

name: sheepBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(SHEEPBOX); sheep whose origin is inside get tossed

name: movementBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: Scn_FindIdList(MOVEMENTBOX); the charge target must be inside and each step must stay inside; their vertical ranges bound the target search | count (+4): count for movementBoxes

name: activationBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: Scn_FindIdList(ACTIVATIONBOX); a noisy Wolf inside wakes the bull | count (+4): count for activationBoxes; 0 means the bull never wakes by proximity

name: noReturnBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(NORETURNBOX); escape volume for state 9

name: target
meaning: current charge target (Wolf, a 0x1e responder such as Gossamer, or the tossed sheep)

name: tossedSheep
meaning: sheep being tossed along tossArc; the toss driver runs while it is set and state == 4

name: gossamer
meaning: Scenaric_FindByClass(0x57 Gossamer_Lev08); inside a movement box it triggers a charge from state 2

name: tossArc
meaning: sheep toss arc: coefficients from SHEEPTRAJ, t at +0x110 (advanced by bull_Update's own quadratic clock, not LaunchArc_Step), obj at +0x118

name: sheepCamShot
meaning: toss camera shot (initialised with noFreeze = 1)

name: dustParams
meaning: Emitter_UpdateDrift params {s32 50, -60, 0x2000, 0x200; u16 size 0x50->0xb4; u8 0}

name: dustEmitter
meaning: dust emitter with inline storage (0x150..0x2b4): bull_Create 0x431c79 forms it at 0x431cb3, slotPool = +0x24 (0x431cbe), particles = +0xe4 (0x431cc9), count 0x10 (0x431cd7), Emitter_Reset 0x52dbe3 (0x431cde) before the final vptr

name: soundHandle
meaning: channel of the charge loop sfx 0xfd or the escape sfx 0xca
